node.title: Pair-feasible E1 rows generate the ambient field
node.statement: At each of the six named clean predecessor anchors, let Q be the canonical cyclic quotient root set of order N in {256,512}, and let B=F_p(Q) be its generated subfield of the ambient field F_q. Every proper B has |B|<2^128 because q<2^256. All six exact pair-feasibility thresholds satisfy b_pair_min>2^128, with bit lengths 134,170,188. Hence |B|>=b_pair_min forces F_p(Q)=F_q. Proper generated-subfield rows remain outside the pair-loss target and require direct image or another supplier.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: ambient generation is automatic on the live pair-feasible E1 branch; this proves no collision bound.
